items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: Now, listen, there is a great blues singer that used to work with Dash and Diana show with me. Her name is Sadie McKinney.

ctx.x: Somebody with a name similar to that made some records in Chicago about five or six years ago.
